title: Thirty sixtieths of final salary
caption: Each year of service earns 1/60 of final salary. After 30 years the accrual is 30/60 = ½, so the pension is half of £45,000: £22,500 a year.
alt: A bar of 60 equal cells with 30 shaded, showing one half.
description: Each year of service earns one sixtieth.
Thirty years give 30 of the 60 sixtieths: ½.
The pension is ½ × £45,000 = £22,500 a year.
